note: Shared vocabulary. Jared names an exercise by any string in `aliases`; Claude resolves it to `id`. Add freely — new entries only need id, name, aliases, pattern.

exercises.name: Clamshell
exercises.cue: Heels together, pelvis stacked and still. The movement is the knee, not the hip rolling back.

exercises.name: Reverse clamshell
exercises.cue: Knees together, lift the top foot. Internal rotation — the direction clamshells miss.

exercises.name: Hip stabs
exercises.reviewNote: Jared's shorthand from PT — exact movement not yet confirmed. Ask before prescribing.

exercises.name: Adductor plank
exercises.cue: Bent knee is the regression. Stop instantly if the groin pinches.
exercises.note: Already prescribed by his PT as of week 1 — do NOT treat this as too advanced.

exercises.name: Arnold press
exercises.cue: Rotate from palms-in to palms-out as you press. Ribs down.

exercises.name: Overhead / shoulder press
exercises.cue: Ribs down. Don't arch your back to get it up.

exercises.name: Lateral raise
exercises.cue: Shoulder height only. No shrug, no swing.

exercises.name: Front raise
exercises.cue: Shoulder height only. Heavily overlaps pressing — low priority when you already pressed.

exercises.name: Rear delt fly
exercises.cue: Thumbs up, no shrugging. The half of the shoulder that presses never trains.

exercises.name: Single-arm dumbbell row
exercises.setup: Hand and knee on a chair seat or couch arm — no bench needed.
exercises.cue: Elbow to your back pocket, pause 2s at the top. If the torso twists, it's momentum.

exercises.name: Single-arm dumbbell row, from the floor
aliases: single arm row from the floor
exercises.cue: Dumbbell resets on the floor each rep — kills momentum, shortens the range.

exercises.name: Prone floor row
aliases: chest supported row on the floor
exercises.setup: Face down on the floor; towel or cushion under the chest for clearance.
exercises.cue: Squeeze the shoulder blades first, then bend the elbows. Short range — the pause is what makes it count.

exercises.name: Chest-supported dumbbell row
exercises.cue: Pull to the hip, not the armpit. Pause a beat at the top.

exercises.name: Bent-over dumbbell row
exercises.cue: Holds you in a hinge the whole set — don't pair it with RDLs on the same day early on.

exercises.name: Dumbbell pullover
exercises.setup: On the floor — no bench needed.
exercises.cue: Ribs pinned to the floor. If your low back arches off, you've gone too far back.

exercises.name: Lat pulldown
exercises.cue: Drive your elbows toward your back pockets.

exercises.name: Dumbbell bench press
exercises.cue: Elbows ~45°, not flared. Touch the chest, no bounce.

exercises.name: Incline dumbbell press
exercises.cue: Low incline, around 30°.

exercises.name: Push-up
exercises.cue: Hands under shoulders, body one line. Counter push-ups are a real push-up.

exercises.name: Incline push-up
exercises.cue: Higher hands are easier. Lowering the surface is the progression.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
exercises.cue: Hips back, not down. Stop where your low back wants to round — that's your range.

exercises.name: Single-leg RDL
exercises.cue: Balance first, load second. Hips square to the floor.

exercises.name: Dumbbell deadlift
exercises.cue: DBs outside your feet, push the floor away. Trap-bar stand-in.

exercises.name: Trap-bar deadlift
exercises.cue: High handles if the gym has them.

exercises.name: Goblet squat
exercises.cue: Stop at the depth where your pelvis stays neutral. Earn depth before weight.

exercises.name: Split squat
exercises.cue: Static, not walking. Back foot on the floor. Torso tall.

exercises.name: Rear-foot-elevated split squat
exercises.cue: Depth will not match side to side, and that's fine.

exercises.name: Low step-up
exercises.cue: Knee height or lower. Drive through the heel, don't push off the back foot.

exercises.name: Glute bridge
exercises.cue: Chin tucked, ribs down, squeeze one full second at the top.

exercises.name: Single-leg glute bridge
exercises.cue: Drive through the heel, keep hips level.

exercises.name: Barbell hip thrust
exercises.cue: Extension with no flexion cost — his single best hip exercise.

exercises.name: Side-lying abduction
exercises.cue: Never let the top leg drop past your body's midline.

exercises.name: Dead bug
exercises.cue: Ribs pinned to the floor. No sit-ups, ever.

exercises.name: Pallof press
exercises.cue: Anti-rotation. Ribs down.

exercises.name: Calf raise
exercises.cue: Full range, pause at the bottom. Robie descent insurance.

exercises.name: Pogo hops
exercises.cue: Stiff ankles, minimal knee bend, quick off the floor.

exercises.name: Eccentric step-down
exercises.cue: Four seconds down. Saves your quads on Robie's descent.

exercises.name: Slider hamstring curl
exercises.cue: Four seconds sliding out. Nordic curl prep.
